englishDefinition: The power or skill to do something.
exampleSentence: She has the ability to run very fast.

englishDefinition: Helpful words that tell you what you should do.
exampleSentence: My teacher gave me good advice about studying.

englishDefinition: To tell people about something in a public way.
exampleSentence: The teacher will announce the winner tomorrow.

englishDefinition: Well known to you because you have seen or heard it before.
exampleSentence: This song sounds familiar to me.

englishDefinition: A new thing that someone makes for the first time.
exampleSentence: The telephone is a very useful invention.

englishDefinition: A piece of metal that can pull other metal things to it.
exampleSentence: The magnet picked up all the little nails.

englishDefinition: To study something carefully to learn more about it.
exampleSentence: We do research about animals in science class.

englishDefinition: A test you do to find out if something is true.
exampleSentence: We did a fun experiment with water in class.

englishDefinition: The knowledge or skill you get from doing things.
exampleSentence: He has a lot of experience playing the piano.

englishDefinition: Having skill or knowledge from doing something many times.
exampleSentence: She is an experienced swimmer.

englishDefinition: To make something better, or to become better.
exampleSentence: I want to improve my English this year.

englishDefinition: Belonging to the present time; new and up to date.
exampleSentence: They live in a modern house with new things.

englishDefinition: A thin book with stories and pictures that comes out often.
exampleSentence: I like to read a magazine about animals.

englishDefinition: A kind of power that makes lights and machines work.
exampleSentence: We use electricity to turn on the lights.

englishDefinition: A very tiny part of an atom that carries electricity.
exampleSentence: An electron is too small to see.

englishDefinition: A long, round, hollow object that air or liquid can go through.
exampleSentence: The water flows through a long tube.

englishDefinition: A picture of someone or something.
exampleSentence: I saw a clear image of the moon.

englishDefinition: To make a picture of something in your mind.
exampleSentence: Close your eyes and imagine a big blue ocean.

englishDefinition: The power of your mind to make pictures and new ideas.
exampleSentence: Children use their imagination when they play.

englishDefinition: To have a different idea or opinion from someone.
exampleSentence: I disagree with you about the best game.

englishDefinition: To think the same way as someone else.
exampleSentence: We all agree that the movie was great.
